name: Wavinai Search
author: Sirvelia

sections.description: Enhance your WooCommerce store with fast, intelligent, and customizable product search functionality. This plugin leverages token-based search algorithms to deliver faster and more accurate product search results. The search interface is thoughtfully designed to enhance user experience and streamline product discovery. Access the Wavinai Search dashboard at /wp-admin/admin.php?page=wavinai-search, where you can: – View detailed search analytics to monitor user behavior and search trends. – Index your WooCommerce products for optimized, token-based search performance. – Customize the search interface visuals to match your store’s branding and enhance user experience.
